clue.text: Lead container for different cookery ingredient

indicators.note: the symbol for lead is pictured as a holder wrapped round the word for different

parts.note: PB is the chemical symbol for lead
different means other

explanation.surface: A lead pot holding some varied thing to be used in cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' looks like a verb or a leash; it is the metal, symbol PB, which holds OTHER.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot-herb is a leafy plant grown to be used in cooking, so it is a culinary ingredient.

clue.text: Interruption of race as result of miners' strike?

definitions.text: Interruption of race as result of miners' strike?

parts.words: Interruption of race as result of miners' strike?
parts.note: a racing driver's halt for fuel and tyres, read whimsically as coal mines ceasing work during industrial action

explanation.surface: A motor race is held up because the coal miners have walked out.
explanation.definitionFit: In motor racing a quick halt in the pits for tyres and fuel interrupts a car's race.

clue.text: Where Pole is loyal to former PM

parts.note: loyal means true
Lord North was British Prime Minister during the American War of Independence

explanation.surface: A Polish person is faithful to an ex-premier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a Polish person; it is the geographic pole. Lord North was a British Prime Minister (1770-82).
explanation.definitionFit: The geographic North Pole lies in the direction of true north, as opposed to magnetic north.

clue.text: Prompt fine stopping one who raised Cain

indicators.note: one word plugs the middle of the other like a stopper in a bottle

parts.note: Eve was the mother of Cain in Genesis
fine means OK

explanation.surface: A penalty halts someone who made a fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raised Cain' looks like making trouble; literally it is the mother who brought up Cain, EVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke something is to call it forth or prompt it, as a memory is prompted.

clue.text: Ship's officer sat in bow with a wound

indicators.note: wound, as in twisted round, says these letters are wound into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A ship's officer sat in the bow with an injury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wound' looks like an injury; it is the past tense of wind, turning SATINBOWA into a new arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A bosun is the petty officer in charge of a ship's rigging, boats and deck crew.

clue.text: See 20
Dope concerning class

parts.note: dope is slang for information, as is gen
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A drug relating to a group of students.
explanation.definitionFit: A genre is a category or kind, especially of art or writing, so it means a class.

clue.text: Admirer of Sandy Wilson fired on by nuts?

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters of the phrase go wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A fan of the songwriter Sandy Wilson is attacked by lunatics.
explanation.walkthrough: Sandy Wilson wrote the 1950s musical The Boy Friend, so the definition is a cryptic pointer to its title.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweetheart admires his partner, and the term was made famous by Sandy Wilson's musical of that name.

clue.text: Confess going in opposite directions after deposing leader

indicators.note: the leader is the first letter, which is thrown out

parts.note: down and up are opposite directions

explanation.surface: Admit to going both ways after a chief is overthrown.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up is an idiom meaning to admit or confess a fault.

clue.text: Treads on one of the family

definitions.meaning: ... means treads on, written as two words
a spouse's son from an earlier marriage, a family member

explanation.definitionFit: A wife's or husband's son by another partner is a relation, one of the family.

clue.text: Sections of trunk road in city

indicators.note: only sections are kept, the opening parts of trunk and road, with their tails cut away

explanation.surface: Parts of a main road run through a city.
explanation.walkthrough: Keep TRU from trunk and RO from road, dropping NK and AD. TRURO is the cathedral city of Cornwall, in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Truro is the only city in Cornwall, England.

clue.text: Can anyone unwind with pain in the neck?

indicators.note: unwind tells the solver to untangle these letters and reset them

explanation.surface: An invitation to relax with someone who is a nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unwind' looks like relaxing; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A pain in the neck is an idiom for something irritating, a nuisance.

clue.text: State in which short film producer turned back clock

indicators.note: turned back means the trimmed name is read from right to left
short means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: Mack Sennett produced silent comedy films such as the Keystone Kops
clock is slang for notice or see

explanation.surface: A US state where a movie-maker reset his timepiece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts SENNETT to SENNET; 'turned back' reverses it to TENNES. 'clock' is not a timepiece but slang for spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennessee is one of the fifty states of the USA.

clue.text: They must be known to be experienced

definitions.text: They must be known to be experienced

parts.words: They must be known to be experienced
parts.note: points at the idiom of knowing the routine of a job, the cords a sailor must learn

explanation.surface: Things you need to know if you are to count as a veteran.
explanation.definitionFit: To know the ropes is an idiom for being experienced in a job, from sailors learning the rigging.

clue.text: Resting place for fish

definitions.meaning: a bar or branch where a bird settles
a freshwater fish with spiny fins

explanation.definitionFit: A bird settles on a perch to rest, and a perch is also a common freshwater fish.

clue.text: Very painful work for the farmer

definitions.meaning: breaking up soil with a spiked implement after ploughing

explanation.definitionFit: A harrowing experience is agonising, and harrowing is the farm job of raking ploughed earth.

clue.text: Extra part for nice actor in play?

indicators.note: in play suggests the letters are being played about with and rearranged

explanation.surface: A bonus role for a pleasant performer in a drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in play' looks like the theatre beside 'actor'; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An accretion is a growth or addition, an extra part attached to something.

clue.text: Person beginning to eat has thrown out stew

indicators.note: the word for thrown sits outside the other pieces

parts.note: thrown means cast
soul means a person, as in not a soul

indicators.note: beginning to says take only the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone starting a meal has tossed the casserole away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown out' looks like rejected; 'out' means CAST goes round SOULE.
explanation.definitionFit: A cassoulet is a French stew of beans with meat, so it is a kind of stew.

clue.text: Northern citizen I vilify in speech

indicators.note: in speech signals that the words are spoken and heard, not spelt

parts.note: taken as written; vilify means to slander

explanation.surface: Someone from the north admits to defaming others when talking.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Iceland is a citizen of a Nordic country in the far north.

clue.text: Supporters present in stand getting excited

indicators.note: in places the word for present inside the rearranged letters
excited letters are stirred up into a new order

parts.note: present means here, as in a roll call

explanation.surface: Fans present in the grandstand become worked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting excited' rearranges STAND into ADNTS, and HERE goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Adherents are followers or supporters of a cause or leader.

clue.text: One in dock, employed by a county council

parts.note: CC is the standard abbreviation for county council
employed means used

explanation.surface: Someone in the dock is on the payroll of the local council.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dock' looks like a harbour; it is the place a defendant stands in a criminal court.
explanation.definitionFit: The defendant in a criminal trial stands in the dock, so the accused is the person there.

clue.text: In Spain, James Bond's last attempt to capture insane extremists?

indicators.note: to capture means the two pieces enclose the extremes of insane
last says take the final letter of the word

parts.note: an attempt is a go

indicators.note: extremists, the outermost letters, gives the first and last of insane

explanation.surface: A Spanish setting where 007's final bid is to seize mad fanatics.
explanation.walkthrough: Diego is the Spanish equivalent of the name James. 'extremists' looks like fanatics; it means the outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Diego is the Spanish form of the name James, as in Santiago.

clue.text: Composer apes composer

parts.note: the composer of this crossword is its setter, who signs as Orlando
gibbons are apes

explanation.surface: A musician imitates another musician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'apes' looks like a verb meaning imitates; it is the noun. The second 'composer' is the setter of this puzzle, Orlando.
explanation.definitionFit: Orlando Gibbons was an English composer of the early seventeenth century.

clue.text: Belief in sacred office

indicators.note: in shows the answer sits within the words sacred office

explanation.surface: Faith in a holy position.
explanation.definitionFit: A credo is a creed, a statement of belief.

clue.text: Plant seen in US, but not before noon

indicators.note: before noon is AM, the time abbreviation, and it is removed

parts.note: the US is America

explanation.surface: A plant found in the USA, but not in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: AM stands for ante meridiem, before noon.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is the genus name for heather, a flowering plant.

clue.text: What's missing from shower?

parts.note: read as a deficit, and also as a brief spell of rain, a quick drop from the sky

explanation.surface: Something absent from a bathroom spray or a rain spell.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortfall is the amount by which something falls short, what is missing.

clue.text: Deliberately avoid front of truck in crash

parts.note: to shun is to avoid deliberately

indicators.note: front of says take the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Steer clear of the lorry's front in an accident.
explanation.definitionFit: A shunt is informal British for a minor collision, a crash between vehicles.

clue.text: Not here? No, no!

definitions.meaning: in that other place, away from this one
a soothing word said doubled to comfort someone, meaning don't cry

explanation.definitionFit: There means in that place, not here, and there, there is said to soothe someone.

clue.text: "Song of Songs" initially associated with religious ceremonies

indicators.note: initially says take the first letter of the word before it

parts.note: pi is short for pious, so religious
ritual means a set of ceremonies

explanation.surface: The biblical Song of Songs is linked to church rites.
explanation.walkthrough: PI, short for pious, is a crossword convention for religious.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiritual is a religious folk song of African American origin.

clue.text: Cockney area of London? That's one way of looking at it

definitions.text: That's one way of looking at it

indicators.note: Cockney speakers drop the H at the start of words

parts.note: Hendon is a district of north London

explanation.surface: A London-accented speaker discussing a district, with a remark about perspective.
explanation.walkthrough: Hendon is a suburb of north-west London; Cockneys, East Londoners, famously drop initial H.
explanation.definitionFit: Viewing something end-on, from its end, is one way of looking at it.

clue.text: Dose could be anything provided by doctor

parts.note: aught is an old word for anything

explanation.surface: A prescription might contain anything the doctor supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A draught is a single drink of liquid medicine, a dose.

clue.text: This used to be played in the Globe before the start of "Othello"

parts.note: the globe means the orb, keeping the article

indicators.note: the start of says take the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: An instrument once heard at Shakespeare's Globe Theatre before Othello began.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the Globe' looks like Shakespeare's theatre in London; it is just THE ORB.
explanation.definitionFit: A theorbo is a large lute of the Baroque era, an instrument that used to be played.
